prompt: copy.deepcopy() and pickle fail on click Parameter, Option and Command objects. Repro: `import copy, click; copy.deepcopy(click.Option(['--name']))` or `pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(click.Option(['--name'])))` raises instead of returning an equivalent object, because the internal UNSET sentinel (click._utils.Sentinel, an Enum whose value is a bare object()) cannot round-trip through the default Enum copy/pickle machinery. Expected: copy.copy, copy.deepcopy and pickle round trips of a Sentinel member return the very same member (identity preserved), and duplicating an Option keeps its default as UNSET and its name.
